comment: rhack() 3708-3711: 'm' then ':' (look, no CMD_M_PREFIX) gives custompline(SUPPRESS_HISTORY, "The look command does not accept 'm' prefix."). The two ^P presses that follow recall the welcome message and the line before it, never the refusal, because putmesg() passes ATR_NOHISTORY and tty_putstr() keeps it out of the message history.
